map.判断膨胀是否落在 30%~45% 的适宜区间，避免过度膨胀损伤纤维。: Judge whether the swelling falls in the suitable 30%~45% band, avoiding over-swelling that damages the fibers.
map.按膨胀率计算皮张吸水增重的质量，用于后续工序投料折算。: Use the swelling rate to compute the extra mass the hides absorb, which is then used to convert charge amounts in later steps.
map.膨胀率(%) = 浓度 × 时间 × 0.08，结果限制在 0~60；膨胀质量(: Swelling rate (%) = concentration × time × 0.08, with the result clamped to 0~60; swelling mass (kg) = hide weight × swelling rate ÷ 100. State rules: 30%~45% is suitable; <30% hydration is insufficient and the time or concentration should be increased; >45% is over-swelling and may damage the fibers so it must be controlled.
map.浓度 5、时间 8 h：膨胀率 = 5×8×0.08 = 3.2%？偏低——按此: Concentration 5, time 8 h: swelling rate = 5×8×0.08 = 3.2%? That is low, so this model needs larger parameters; take concentration 25, time 20 h: 25×20×0.08 = 40%, which lands in the suitable band; at a hide weight of 100 kg the swelling mass = 100×40/100 = 40 kg. At concentration 30 and time 25 h: 30×25×0.08 = 60%, which has hit the cap and is judged over-swelling.
map.膨胀率过大有什么危害？: What is the harm of too large a swelling rate?
map.过度膨胀会使纤维过度分散、皮张松软甚至损伤粒面，成革易松面且强度下降；应通过降低: Over-swelling disperses the fibers too much, leaving the hide soft and possibly damaging the grain, so the finished leather grains out and loses strength; control it by lowering the alkali concentration or shortening the time.
map.模型为经验线性外推，超过约 60% 已脱离正常工艺范围，继续外推不再有参考价值，: The model is an empirical linear extrapolation, and beyond about 60% it has already left the normal process range, so further extrapolation has no reference value and is capped.
map.浸灰膨胀计算工具依据石灰浓度、浸灰时间与皮重，估算皮胶原的膨胀率与膨胀质量，帮助: The Liming Swelling Calculation tool estimates the swelling rate and swelling mass of hide collagen from lime concentration, liming time and hide weight, helping control the degree of swelling in the liming step and avoiding fiber damage from over-swelling.
map.膨胀率与质量同时计算: Swelling rate and mass computed together
